_readme: The battle glossary: the terms the skill detail card highlights in skill text, and what tapping one shows. Presentation only (never read by the battle). Each term: TermId (stable lowercase snake_case), Term (the name shown as the definition's title, and what [[shown text|Term]] markup in a description names), Category (Status, Combat, Stance or Passive), Forms (the words that are highlighted wherever they appear in skill text as a whole word: a form written in lowercase also matches with a capital first letter, at the start of a sentence; a form with a capital, a proper name such as a stance, matches only exactly; the longest form wins, then the earlier term) and Definition (one or two plain sentences, true to the rules in docs/design/battle-system.md). No form may belong to two terms. Validated by BeastCraft.Presentation.Text.GlossaryValidator on every content load: the file itself, every [[...]] mark in skill text names a term, and every beast skill, avatar active and passive that applies a status names it in its description.

Terms.Definition: A stunned unit loses its next turn: it cannot move or use skills, and its cooldowns do not count down. Being frozen or turned to stone is a stun.
Soaks up damage before any HP is lost, for a few turns. Its strength is a share of the caster's Defense; a unit keeps only its strongest shield.
A taunted enemy must aim its single-target and line skills at the unit that taunted it, walking toward it if it is out of reach, until the taunt ends.
Fire damage over time: the unit loses a fixed amount of HP at the start of each of its turns while it lasts. Burns can stack.
Damage over time from anything but fire: the unit loses a fixed amount of HP at the start of each of its turns while it lasts. Poison can stack.
Clears every stun, burn and poison from the unit at once. Shields and taunts stay.
Pushes the unit a number of hexes straight away from the caster, stopping early at a blocked or occupied tile or the edge of the arena.
Lowers the unit's Speed for a few turns, so it acts less often.
A critical hit deals one and a half times the damage. Every hit rolls its own chance to crit, from the attacker's crit chance.
Restores HP, never above the unit's maximum. A heal's strength scales with the healer's Special Attack.
A passive that is always on: its effect holds for the whole battle.
The front-line stance: walks straight in, stands between the enemy and its more fragile allies, and never retreats.
Keeps its distance: approaches only as far as its skills need, never walks into melee, and backs away from nearby enemies.
Hit and run: closes in and strikes like a Vanguard, then spends any movement left retreating.
